result.title: PointerBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained GUI Grounding
result.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET), NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have shown promising performance in computer-use tasks, from planning user workflows to grounding natural-language actions to precise UI targets. Existing end-to-end benchmarks primarily emphasize long-horizon task completion, while GUI grounding benchmarks remain focused on conventional controls and a limited set of professional interfaces. We introduce POINTERBENCH, a diagnostic suite of 1,500 screenshot-instruction pairs probing three complementary capabilities: thin sub-element identification and geometric grounding in spreadsheets (POINTERBENCH-Sheets), character-level grounding in long-text documents (POINTERBENCH-Text), and mixed GUI grounding across 100 professional applications (POINTERBENCH-Pro). We carefully curate each task with pixel-exact target geometry and evaluate both general-purpose multimodal models and 39 specialist GUI grounding configurations. We find text grounding to be the most challenging setting, with Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and the leading native specialist UI-Venus-2-9B achieving 69.6%, 53.4%, and 25.8% success on POINTERBENCH-Text despite respective 83.2%, 77.7%, and 54.5% average success across POINTERBENCH. These results reveal substantial headroom in fine-grained GUI grounding across frontier and specialist models. We publicly release the benchmark and evaluation code at https://github.com/warmwindOS/pointerbench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PointerBench 诊断基准，含 1500 个截图-指令对，覆盖表格亚元素几何定位、长文档字符级定位与 100 个专业应用中的混合 GUI 定位，并评测通用多模态模型与 39 种专用 GUI 配置，发现文本定位最具挑战。
AI.relevance_reason: 像素级几何与字符级定位可直接检验 VLM 内部是否保留足够细的视觉信息，为「视觉细节坍缩」与证据获取提供诊断入口；但该工作不涉及 latent 状态生成或推理轨迹，与 LVR 推理过程的联系需核查原文。
